# NamasteQR - Restaurant & Hotel Management Portal

> NamasteQR (https://namasteqr.com) is a modern all-in-one restaurant and hotel operations portal featuring contact-free digital QR menus, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), waiter station monitors, billing & POS register, WhatsApp OTP table check-ins, and thermal receipt printing.

## Core Services & Features
- [Digital QR Code Ordering](https://namasteqr.com/menu-preview): Interactive multilingual digital menu for dine-in tables, takeaway, and room service.
- [Kitchen Display System (KDS)](https://namasteqr.com): Real-time station monitor for kitchen and bar workflows with sub-second order dispatch.
- [Billing & POS Management](https://namasteqr.com): Full cashier POS, sales register, VAT/tax reporting, Excel exports, and invoice printing.
- [Staff Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)](https://namasteqr.com): Secure granular permissions for Managers, Cashiers, Waiters, and Kitchen Staff.
